_howto: Bi-weekly Gen 2 update lives here. Per set: 'done' = stages fully completed (1 Direction, 2 Concepts, 3 Sketches, 4 Final art, 5 In game), 'active' = being worked right now (shows the next stage as in-progress), optional 'status':'next' shows an 'Up next' chip on a queued set. 'note' is shown verbatim on the card; 'focus' is the global 'next two weeks' line; 'updated' is the announcement date (YYYY-MM-DD) — the site shows the next update as +14 days. Optional translations per entry: "i18n": { "pt": { "note": "…" } }.
focus: Right now it's all about landing the Zombies: the last sketches are being finished and final art is moving item by item. Vampire concept exploration lines up next — expect the first peeks in an upcoming update.
